description: Get the ohmyho.st customer/agent identity this call acts as: user and account email, scoped organization IDs and names and, in context, the saved login or OHMYHOST_TOKEN that supplied it. Compare it with the user and organization the customer named before any change. This does not authenticate the hosted application's end users or provision a customer AuthKit tenant; application authentication is the customer's chosen integration.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: identity_get
